en.headline: Observatory issues special tip as showers increase tonight with possible thunderstorms
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory said upper-air disturbances will bring more showers this evening, with isolated squally thunderstorms and stronger winds, before heavier rain early on Saturday.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued a special weather tip at 11:45 am on Friday, warning that showers will gradually increase tonight as upper-air disturbances approach, with isolated squally thunderstorms and stronger winds in some areas.

The Observatory said the rain is expected to be quite heavy early on Saturday before easing during the day as the disturbances move away, with sunny periods possible in the afternoon. It advised the public to stay updated on the latest weather information and to take care during outdoor activities.

No Thunderstorm Warning was in force at the time of the tip. The Observatory had earlier forecast mainly cloudy conditions on Friday with sunny intervals during the day and temperatures between 23 and 26 degrees, turning showery later.

zh.headline: 天文台發特別天氣提示 今晚驟雨增多或有狂風雷暴
zh.dek: 天文台上午11時45分發出提示，指高空擾動靠近，本港今晚驟雨逐漸增多，局部地區有狂風雷暴及較大風勢，周六初時雨勢頗大。
body: 香港天文台周五上午11時45分發出特別天氣提示，指隨著高空擾動靠近，預料本港今晚驟雨逐漸增多，局部地區有狂風雷暴，風勢較大。
天文台表示，明日初時雨勢頗大，隨著擾動遠離，日間驟雨減少，天色好轉，下午部分時間有陽光。天文台提醒市民留意最新天氣消息，進行戶外活動時注意天氣變化。
發出提示時並無雷暴警告生效。天文台較早時預測周五大致多雲，日間短暫有陽光，氣溫約23至26度，稍後有驟雨。
